title: Polaris Key docs
summary: The public landing offers the Help, Developers and member-only Operate doors, a docs search trigger and top Help tasks without hero art.
compare: Landing has no hero art and names Help, Developers and Operate as equal doors.
Only Operate is labelled For console members: developers are public in docs access code.
The title uses the display step and task tiles stack without horizontal scroll on phone.

designReview.reviewer: pkey-ux-reviewer (rendered consumer, developer and brand lenses)
designReview.verdict: The shared brand pass now gives the public docs home the display hierarchy used by the portal and console family.

findings.issue: The home title inherited the 24/32 article heading at desktop and phone.
findings.resolution: Scoped home titles to the 40/48 desktop and 30/36 phone display steps without changing article headings.
